2024_general.fact: Clarity EID 122753 (listed in Bastrop elections.json as "General and Special Elections" 11/5/2024). Election-night versions: v351384 Timestamp "11/5/2024 8:18:59 PM CST" has precinct votes only under VoteType "Early Voting"/"Absentee" (opened: <Precinct name="Precinct 1001" votes="157"> under Early Voting); v352888 "11/5/2024 11:35:09 PM CST" is the first with election-day candidate precinct votes (opened: President, "REP Donald J. Trump/JD Vance", VoteType "Election Day", <Precinct name="Precinct 1001" votes="39">; 26 precincts). One election-night release with election-day precinct numbers. Caveat: version 352384 (between them) returns HTTP 404 and could not be read.

2026_primary.fact: EID 126012. v368435 "3/3/2026 8:28:11 PM CST" no election-day precinct votes; v368507 "9:58:29 PM CST" REP US Senator, VoteType "Election Day", <Precinct name="Precinct 1002" votes="1">, 26 precincts, candidate election-day sum 213255; v368540 "11:03:08 PM CST" same precincts, sum 236570. 2026_runoff.fact: EID 126363. v372936 "5/26/2026 7:16:18 PM CDT" no election-day precinct votes; v373011 "9:12:08 PM CDT" REP US Senator "John Cornyn", VoteType "Election Day", <Precinct name="Poll 1" votes="185">. One release. Caveat: the runoff reporting units are four combined polling places ("Poll 1" to "Poll 4"), not individual precincts.

rationale: Two of three elections are END from check 1 (2024 general and runoff); the primary is LIVE. Rule gives PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT. Caveats: an unreadable 2024 election-night version (352384, HTTP 404) could hide a second release, and runoff units are combined polling places.
